literature.headline_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期乙型肝炎病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 年龄较大、糖尿病的存在以及较低的血清白蛋白水平与对乙型肝炎疫苗接种的不良或无反应显著相关(p<0.05)。 [PMID:42811835]
NHANES中较高的ln(WHR)与肌少症独立相关(调整后OR = 2.50;95% CI:2.01–3.10),并在KNHANES中一致验证(OR = 1.85;95% CI:1.49–2.29)。 [10.1111/ggi.70858]

与HBV-DNA阴性组相比,HBV-DNA阳性与肝损伤加重显著相关,表现为ALT、AST升高,淋巴细胞计数增加以及纤维化评分(APRI和FIB-4)升高。无论HBV-DNA状态如何或肝病阶段(慢性乙型肝炎或肝硬化),EBV-DNA阳性均与血浆白蛋白(Alb)水平和白蛋白-球蛋白(A/G)比值显著降低相关,与EBV-DNA阴性患者相比。A/G比值的降低归因于白蛋白水平的下降,而非球蛋白(Glb)水平的升高。 [10.1002/jmv.71071]
两名患者报告称他们曾知晓自己的HBV感染状况,但已不再接受医疗随访且未进行HDV筛查。 [10.17235/reed.2026.12194/2026]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Older age, presence of diabetes mellitus, and lower serum albumin were significantly associated with poor or non-response to hepatitis B vaccination (p<0.05). [PMID:42811835]
A total of 28 448 patients were included, of whom 19 001 (66.8%) showed high adherence and 9447 (33.2%) showed low adherence. [10.1002/jmv.71167]
Higher ln(WHR) was independently associated with sarcopenia in NHANES (adjusted OR = 2.50; 95% CI: 2.01–3.10) and consistently validated in KNHANES (OR = 1.85; 95% CI: 1.49–2.29). [10.1111/ggi.70858]

Compared to the HBV-DNA-negative group, HBV-DNA-positivity was significantly associated with aggravated hepatic injury, as evidenced by elevated ALT, AST, lymphocyte count, and fibrosis scores (APRI and FIB-4). [10.1002/jmv.71071]
Two patients reported having been aware of their HBV diagnosis but were no longer engaged to healthcare follow-up and had not undergone HDV screening. [10.17235/reed.2026.12194/2026]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.
literature.brief_en: This literature brief prioritizes papers published in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency, and independent-source convergence. Detailed study-specific evidence is retained in the article cards below.
brief_items_zh: 本期乙型肝炎病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
年龄较大、糖尿病的存在以及较低的血清白蛋白水平与对乙型肝炎疫苗接种的不良或无反应显著相关(p<0.05)。 [PMID:42811835]。
NHANES中较高的ln(WHR)与肌少症独立相关(调整后OR = 2.50;95% CI:2.01–3.10),并在KNHANES中一致验证(OR = 1.85;95% CI:1.49–2.29)。 [10.1111/ggi.70858]。

与HBV-DNA阴性组相比,HBV-DNA阳性与肝损伤加重显著相关,表现为ALT、AST升高,淋巴细胞计数增加以及纤维化评分(APRI和FIB-4)升高。无论HBV-DNA状态如何或肝病阶段(慢性乙型肝炎或肝硬化),EBV-DNA阳性均与血浆白蛋白(Alb)水平和白蛋白-球蛋白(A/G)比值显著降低相关,与EBV-DNA阴性患者相比。A/G比值的降低归因于白蛋白水平的下降,而非球蛋白(Glb)水平的升高。
brief_items_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
Older age, presence of diabetes mellitus, and lower serum albumin were significantly associated with poor or non-response to hepatitis B vaccination (p<0.05). [PMID:42811835].
A total of 28 448 patients were included, of whom 19 001 (66.8%) showed high adherence and 9447 (33.2%) showed low adherence. [10.1002/jmv.71167].

Higher ln(WHR) was independently associated with sarcopenia in NHANES (adjusted OR = 2.50; 95% CI: 2.01–3.10) and consistently validated in KNHANES (OR = 1.85; 95% CI: 1.49–2.29). [10.1111/ggi.70858].

Compared to the HBV-DNA-negative group, HBV-DNA-positivity was significantly associated with aggravated hepatic injury, as evidenced by elevated ALT, AST, lymphocyte count, and fibrosis scores (APRI and FIB-4).

papers.title: Review Article: Cancer Surveillance for Early Detection of Liver Cancer in Patients with HBV Infection
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background and Aims Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major cause of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Although antiviral therapy reduces cirrhosis and liver failure, HCC may still develop in patients with HBV, including in non‐cirrhotic livers. This review aimed to evaluate current HCC surveillance strategies in HBV infection, focusing on risk stratification and advances in early detection. Methods English‐language literature published in PubMed and the Cochrane Database was comprehensively reviewed. This narrative review assessed the effectiveness of HCC surveillance strategies in HBV‐infected patients, with emphasis on recent advances in early‐stage HCC detection. Results This review summarizes viral, host and environmental factors associated with HCC susceptibility and evaluates current surveillance using ultrasound with or without alpha‐fetoprotein (AFP). Surveillance eligibility should follow guideline‐defined risk criteria: patients with an estimated annual HCC risk below 0.2% generally do not require routine surveillance and should undergo periodic risk reassessment, whereas patients meeting surveillance criteria should undergo ultrasound with or without AFP every 6 months. Risk‐prediction scores can refine assessment but should be distinguished from early‐detection tests. GALAD, HES 2.0, multi‐target blood tests, and abbreviated magnetic resonance imaging are promising early‐detection approaches, but much of the supporting evidence derives from mixed‐aetiology or non‐HBV cohorts and prospective HBV‐specific validation remains limited. Conclusion A risk‐adapted approach should separate estimation of future HCC risk from surveillance and early‐detection testing. Guideline‐eligible patients should undergo surveillance every 6 months, while emerging biomarker, imaging and artificial‐intelligence approaches remain adjunctive or investigational pending further HBV‐specific validation.

It highlights the role of ultrasound with or without AFP in monitoring HBV-infected individuals and discusses the limitations of existing evidence. papers.title: High Treatment Adherence Is Associated With Lower Observed HCC Risk in Patients With Chronic Hepatitis B and Cirrhosis: A Nationwide Claims‐Based Cohort Study
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Adherence to antiviral therapy is essential for viral suppression in chronic hepatitis B (CHB), yet its effect on hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remains uncertain. We examined the association between nucleos(t)ide analog (NA) adherence and HCC risk, focusing on tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) versus entecavir (ETV). Treatment‐naïve adults with CHB initiating TAF or ETV were identified from the Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service, Republic of Korea. Adherence was measured using the medication possession ratio, with high adherence defined as ≥ 90%, and the primary outcome was HCC incidence. A total of 28 448 patients were included, of whom 19 001 (66.8%) showed high adherence and 9447 (33.2%) showed low adherence. In the overall cohort, HCC incidence was comparable between the high‐ and low‐adherence groups (14.89 vs. 13.76 per 1000 person‐years; IRR, 1.08; 95% CI, 0.95–1.24). Among patients with claims‐defined cirrhosis, however, high adherence was associated with lower observed HCC incidence (32.92 vs. 49.59 per 1000 person‐years; IRR, 0.66; 95% CI, 0.57–0.78), and this association remained significant in multivariable Cox regression (HR, 0.77; 95% CI, 0.66–0.90) as well as in IPTW, landmark, and sensitivity analyses. In exploratory regimen‐stratified analyses, high‐adherence TAF users showed a lower observed cumulative HCC incidence than high‐adherence ETV users, whereas no significant difference was observed in the low‐adherence group. Logistic regression identified ETV use as a predictor of low adherence (OR, 2.80; 95% CI, 2.65–2.96). High adherence to antiviral therapy was associated with lower observed HCC incidence among patients with CHB and claims‐defined cirrhosis. Although this association remained evident across multiple analyses, residual confounding, treatment‐selection effects, time‐related bias, and competing‐risk issues cannot be fully excluded.

We examined the association between nucleos(t)ide analog (NA) adherence and HCC risk, focusing on tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) versus entecavir (ETV). Treatment-naïve adults with CHB initiating TAF or ETV were identified from the Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service, Republic of Korea. Adherence was measured using the medication possession ratio, with high adherence defined as ≥ 90%, and the primary outcome was HCC incidence. A total of 28 448 patients were included, of whom 19 001 (66.8%) showed high adherence and 9447 (33.2%) showed low adherence. In the overall cohort, HCC incidence was comparable between the high- and low-adherence groups (14.89 vs. 13.76 per 1000 person-years; IRR, 1.08; 95% CI, 0.95-1.24). Among patients with claims-defined cirrhosis, however, high adherence was associated with lower observed HCC incidence (32.92 vs. 49.59 per 1000 person-years; IRR, 0.66; 95% CI, 0.57-0.78), and this association remained significant in multivariable Cox regression (HR, 0.77; 95% CI, 0.66-0.90) as well as in IPTW, landmark, and sensitivity analyses. In exploratory regimen-stratified analyses, high-adherence TAF users showed a lower observed cumulative HCC incidence than high-adherence ETV users, whereas no significant difference was observed in the low-adherence group. Logistic regression identified ETV use as a predictor of low adherence (OR, 2.80; 95% CI, 2.65-2.96). High adherence to antiviral therapy was associated with lower observed HCC incidence among patients with CHB and claims-defined cirrhosis. Although this association remained evident across multiple analyses, residual confounding, treatment-selection effects, time-related bias, and competing-risk issues cannot be fully excluded.

papers.title: Neurological Complications of Oncogenic Viruses: Mechanisms, Clinical Manifestations, and Emerging Insights.
papers.abstract: Oncogenic viruses are widely recognized for their pivotal role in malignant transformation; however, their capacity to induce neurological disorders has received comparatively less attention. Increasing evidence indicates that several oncogenic viruses, including human T-cell leukemia virus type 1 (HTLV-1), human papillomavirus (HPV), hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), and Kaposi's sarcoma-associated herpesvirus (KSHV), are associated with a broad spectrum of neurological complications involving both the central and peripheral nervous systems. These manifestations arise through diverse mechanisms, including direct viral neuroinvasion, persistent infection, immune-mediated tissue injury, chronic neuroinflammation, and disruption of neurovascular integrity. Moreover, virus-induced molecular alterations, such as oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, epigenetic remodelling, and aberrant cytokine signalling, contribute t neuronal dysfunction and disease progression. In this review, we critically examine the current understanding of the neurological complications associated with major oncogenic viruses by integrating evidence from molecular, experimental, and clinical studies. We first discuss the general mechanisms by which viral infections induce neurological injury, highlighting pathways shared among neurotropic and non-neurotropic viruses. We then summarise the neurological manifestations and virus-specific pathogenic mechanisms associated with each oncogenic virus, emphasising both common and distinct molecular pathways underlying neuropathogenesis. Finally, we address current diagnostic challenges, emerging biomarkers, and therapeutic strategies while identifying critical knowledge gaps that limit causal interpretation and clinical translation. A comprehensive understanding of the complex interactions between oncogenic viruses, the immune system, and the nervous system will facilitate earlier diagnosis, improve patient management, and support the development of targeted therapeutic approaches for virus-associated neurological disorders.

These manifestations arise through diverse mechanisms, including direct viral neuroinvasion, persistent infection, immune-mediated tissue injury, chronic neuroinflammation, and disruption of neurovascular integrity. Moreover, virus-induced molecular alterations, such as oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, epigenetic remodelling, and aberrant cytokine signalling, contribute t neuronal dysfunction and disease progression. In this review, we critically examine the current understanding of the neurological complications associated with major oncogenic viruses by integrating evidence from molecular, experimental, and clinical studies. We first discuss the general mechanisms by which viral infections induce neurological injury, highlighting pathways shared among neurotropic and non-neurotropic viruses. We then summarise the neurological manifestations and virus-specific pathogenic mechanisms associated with each oncogenic virus, emphasising both common and distinct molecular pathways underlying neuropathogenesis. Finally, we address current diagnostic challenges, emerging biomarkers, and therapeutic strategies while identifying critical knowledge gaps that limit causal interpretation and clinical translation. A comprehensive understanding of the complex interactions between oncogenic viruses, the immune system, and the nervous system will facilitate earlier diagnosis, improve patient management, and support the development of targeted therapeutic approaches for virus-associated neurological disorders.

The evidence highlights that HBV can induce neurological disorders through pathways such as direct neuroinvasion, immune-mediated injury, and molecular alterations. papers.abstract_zh: 致癌病毒因其在恶性转化中的关键作用而被广泛认可。然而,它们引起神经系统疾病的能力相对较少受到关注。越来越多的证据表明,多种致癌病毒,包括人 T 细胞白血病病毒 1 型 (HTLV-1)、人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV)、乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV)、丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 和卡波西肉瘤相关疱疹病毒 (KSHV),与涉及中枢和周围神经系统的广泛神经系统并发症有关。这些表现是通过多种机制产生的,包括直接病毒神经侵袭、持续感染、免疫介导的组织损伤、慢性神经炎症和神经血管完整性破坏。此外,病毒诱导的分子改变,如氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍、表观遗传重塑和异常的细胞因子信号传导,会导致神经元功能障碍和疾病进展。在这篇综述中,我们通过整合分子、实验和临床研究的证据,批判性地研究了目前对与主要致癌病毒相关的神经并发症的理解。我们首先讨论病毒感染引起神经损伤的一般机制,强调嗜神经病毒和非嗜神经病毒之间共享的途径。然后,我们总结了与每种致癌病毒相关的神经学表现和病毒特异性致病机制,强调神经发病机制中常见和独特的分子途径。最后,我们解决当前的诊断挑战、新兴生物标志物和治疗策略,同时确定限制因果解释和临床转化的关键知识差距。全面了解致癌病毒、免疫系统和神经系统之间复杂的相互作用将有助于早期 诊断,改善患者管理,并支持开发针对病毒相关神经系统疾病的靶向治疗方法。

papers.title: HBV/HCV coinfection and anti-tuberculosis drug-induced liver injury: from risk assessment and exploration of mechanisms to preventive considerations
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: Anti-tuberculosis drug-induced liver injury (AT-DILI) is a common and clinically significant adverse event during tuberculosis treatment. Previous studies have frequently reported an increased risk of AT-DILI among patients coinfected with hepatitis B virus (HBV) and/or hepatitis C virus (HCV). This review aims to explore potential mechanisms underlying this heightened susceptibility and to discuss prevention considerations for patients with tuberculosis and HBV/HCV coinfection. METHODS: We conducted a comprehensive literature search across PubMed, Web of Science, and Google Scholar, supplemented by clinical guidelines and authoritative reports, to identify relevant studies published through August 2026. Relevant articles were screened and thematically organized to synthesize evidence on risk estimation, underlying mechanisms, and prevention considerations. RESULTS: Available evidence indicates that HBV/HCV coinfection is associated with increased AT-DILI risk, with the magnitude varying by viral activity, baseline liver disease, and virological indicator selection. Higher viral loads appear more closely associated with AT-DILI risk. Potential mechanisms include immune-inflammatory changes, altered drug metabolism, reduced hepatic reserve, and virus-specific liver injury, including HBV reactivation. These observations inform preventive strategies targeting these risks and potential mechanisms, including baseline hepatic and virological assessment, dynamic monitoring, antiviral therapy, individualized anti-tuberculosis regimen optimization, and selective use of hepatoprotective agents. CONCLUSION: HBV/HCV coinfection increases the risk of AT-DILI and warrants active clinical attention. Future efforts should focus on individualizing prevention based on virological and hepatic status, while validating emerging biomarkers and artificial intelligence-based predictive tools to refine risk identification.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的:抗结核药物引起的肝损伤(AT-DILI)是结核病 治疗 期间常见且具有临床意义的不良事件。先前的研究经常报告,同时感染 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 和/或丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 的患者发生 AT-DILI 的风险增加。本综述旨在探讨这种易感性升高的潜在机制,并讨论结核病和 HBV/HCV 合并感染患者的预防注意事项。方法:我们在 PubMed、Web of Science 和 Google Scholar 上进行了全面的文献检索,并辅以临床指南和权威报告,以确定截至 2026 年 8 月发表的相关研究。筛选并按主题组织相关文章,以综合有关风险估计、潜在机制和预防考虑因素的证据。结果:现有证据表明 HBV/HCV 合并感染与 AT-DILI 风险增加相关,其程度因病毒活动、基线肝病和病毒学指标选择而异。较高的病毒载量似乎与 AT-DILI 风险更密切相关。潜在的机制包括免疫炎症变化、药物代谢改变、肝储备减少和病毒特异性肝损伤,包括 HBV 再激活。这些观察结果为针对这些风险和潜在机制的预防策略提供了信息,包括基线肝脏和病毒学评估、动态监测、抗病毒药物治疗、个体化抗结核方案优化以及选择性使用保肝药物。结论:HBV/HCV 合并感染会增加 AT-DILI 的风险,值得临床积极关注。未来的努力应侧重于基于病毒学和肝脏状况的个体化预防,同时验证新兴生物标志物和基于人工智能的预测工具以完善风险识别。

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the vaccination rates of hepatitis B virus among liver transplant recipients in the United States, using data from the United Network for Organ Sharing database between 2022 and 2024. It highlights that only 59.9% of recipients were vaccinated, with significant regional and clinicodemographic variations. The authors suggest that multilevel interventions and the use of more immunogenic vaccines could improve these rates. The findings underscore the need for better vaccination strategies to prevent HBV infection in this vulnerable population. However, the study's reliance on a single database introduces limitations, and the evidence is considered moderate. The results have important implications for public health and clinical practice, emphasizing the importance of targeted efforts to enhance vaccination coverage.

papers.title: Evaluation of the immunogenicity of hepatitis B vaccination in hematopoietic stem cell transplant recipients vaccinated with a hexavalent vaccine compared with patients vaccinated with a combined hepatitis A and B vaccine
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: In 2020, the Catalan Department of Health recommended a pediatric hexavalent vaccine for adult hematopoietic stem cell transplant (HSCT) recipients. Previously, patients at our center received a combined hepatitis A + B vaccine with double the hepatitis B antigen content. The immunogenicity of the hexavalent formulation in this population remains unclear. OBJECTIVE: To compare immunogenicity of two hepatitis B vaccination strategies in adult HSCT recipients and identify predictors of response. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study including adult HSCT recipients vaccinated between 2017 and 2023 in a tertiary hospital in Barcelona. Patients received hepatitis A + B vaccine (2017-2019) or hexavalent vaccine (2020-2023). Seroprotection was defined as HBsAb ≥10 IU/mL one month after the third dose. Univariate and multivariate logistic regression were used to identify factors associated with seroresponse. RESULTS: A total of 331 patients were included (median age 54.6 years; 42.3% female). Seroprotection rates were higher with the hexavalent vaccine compared to hepatitis A + B (70.1% vs. Median HBsAb titers were higher but not statistically significant (668 vs. 375 IU/mL; p = 0.261) in the hexavalent group. In multivariate analysis, hexavalent vaccination (OR 4.27, 95% CI 2.88-6.36) and pre-HSCT seroprotection (OR 9.36, 95% CI 5.46-16.03) were associated with higher response. Tacrolimus use and multiple myeloma were associated with lower response. CONCLUSIONS: Despite lower antigen content, the hexavalent vaccine was associated with significantly higher seroprotection in adult HSCT recipients. Pre-existing protective HBsAb titers enhanced response, whereas tacrolimus exposure and multiple myeloma were associated with reduced immunogenicity.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在比较两种乙型肝炎病毒疫苗接种疫苗接种策略在成年HSCT受者中的免疫原性,并确定免疫应答的预测因素。背景强调了在这一人群中明确六联疫苗疫苗效果的必要性。

elements_zh.main_results: Seroprotection rates were higher with the hexavalent vaccine compared to hepatitis A + B (70.1% vs. Median HBsAb titers were higher but not statistically significant (668 vs. 375 IU/mL; p = 0.261) in the hexavalent group. elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释称,尽管六联疫苗疫苗的抗原含量较低,但其在成年HSCT受者中与显著更高的血清保护相关。他们确定了既往保护性HBsAb滴度作为免疫应答的预测因素,同时指出他克莫司暴露和多发性骨髓瘤与免疫原性降低相关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为成年HSCT受者的疫苗接种策略提供了信息,突出了六联疫苗疫苗的潜在优势,并强调了既往免疫力和免疫抑制治疗对疫苗应答的影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到回顾性设计和潜在混杂因素的限制。证据强度中等,因为结果基于观察性数据,而非随机对照试验。

papers.title: A Markov model cost threshold analysis of potential hepatitis B virus cure regimens
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Novel treatment regimens to achieve functional cure (FC) of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) may soon be available. We aimed to evaluate treatment cost-effectiveness thresholds for a potential cure regimen in the U.S. and China using a Markov model, with long-term nucleos(t)ide analogue (NUC) treatment as reference. METHODS: We simulated disease progression comparing achieving FC defined as HBsAg loss and unquantifiable HBV DNA 24 weeks off treatment with a novel therapeutic regimen to long-term NUC treatment. Cost-effectiveness thresholds for FC of CHB, incorporating various anticipated success rates for FC, incidence rates of major liver outcomes including hepatocellular carcinoma post-FC, health utility values, and medical costs, were estimated. RESULTS: The base case was a 50-year-old man with hepatitis B e antigen (HBeAg)-negative non-cirrhotic CHB and NUC-suppressed HBV DNA ≥1year. Compared to long-term NUC, a 30% effective FC regimen would yield 17.18 and 16.14 quality-adjusted life years (QALYs), and 0.30 and 0.57 QALYs gained per patient in the U.S. and China, respectively. With an HCC annual incidence rate of 0.1% after FC, a FC regimen could be cost-effective at a one-time treatment cost under the threshold of USD46,642 in the U.S., and USD13,008 in China. The cost-effectiveness threshold increases with higher FC rates, younger patients, and increasing medical costs, but may be lower in women. DISCUSSION: A Markov model-based cost-effectiveness analysis demonstrates that CHB cure regimen with 30% FC in aforementioned base case could be cost-effective at a threshold of USD46,642 in the U.S. and USD13,008 in China.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 新型治疗方案以实现功能性治愈(功能性治愈)的慢性乙型肝炎(慢性乙型肝炎)可能即将问世。本研究旨在利用马尔可夫模型,评估治疗在美中两国潜在治愈方案中的成本效益阈值,以长期核苷(酸)类似物(NUC)治疗作为参考。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究模拟了疾病进展,比较了以HBsAg消失和HBV DNA不可量化作为功能性治愈(FC)标准的治疗方案在24周后与新型治疗方案的效果,以及与长期使用NUC治疗的对比。基线案例为一名50岁的男性,患有乙型肝炎e抗原(HBeAg)阴性、非肝硬化的慢性乙型肝炎(CHB),且HBV DNA已被NUC抑制≥1年。
elements_zh.methods: 功能性治愈慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)的成本效果阈值,结合了功能性治愈(FC)的各种预期成功率、功能性治愈后主要肝脏结局(包括肝细胞癌)的发生率、健康效用值以及医疗成本,通过马尔可夫模型进行了估算。
elements_zh.main_results: 一种30%有效的FC方案在美国和中国分别可获得17.18和16.14个质量调整生命年(QALYs),每位患者分别获得0.30和0.57个QALYs的增益。成本效果阈值随着更高的FC率、更年轻的患者和医疗成本的增加而上升,但在女性中可能较低。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: A Markov model-based cost-effectiveness analysis demonstrates that CHB cure regimen with 30% FC in aforementioned base case could be cost-effective at a threshold of USD46,642 in the U.S. and USD13,008 in China.
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为美国和中国潜在的乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)治愈方案的成本效益决策提供信息,特别是针对HBeAg阴性、非肝硬化的慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者以及接受核苷(酸)类似物(NUC)治疗且HBV DNA被抑制≥1年的患者。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受限于其依赖预期成功率和发病率率来评估肝病结果,这些数据可能无法反映真实世界的情况。由于其基于模拟数据和假设,证据强度为中等。

papers.title: Impact of resolved hepatitis B virus infection on clinical outcomes in patients with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma: a supplementary analysis of JCOG0601
papers.abstract: The impact of resolved hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection, defined as pretreatment hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) negativity with antibody to hepatitis B core antigen (anti-HBc) positivity, on the clinical characteristics and outcomes of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) remains unclear. JCOG0601 was a randomized phase II/III trial showing no improvement in progression-free survival (PFS) with dose-dense rituximab plus CHOP in previously untreated DLBCL. This supplementary analysis of JCOG0601 evaluated whether baseline anti-HBc positivity affects PFS and overall survival (OS) in patients with HBsAg-negative DLBCL treated with rituximab-containing CHOP-based therapy. Among 406 eligible patients randomly assigned in JCOG0601, 405 with available baseline HBV serologic data were included. Baseline characteristics and outcomes were compared according to anti-HBc status. Of the 405 patients, 87 were anti-HBc-positive and 318 were anti-HBc-negative. Anti-HBc-positive patients were older than anti-HBc-negative patients (median age, 63 vs. 61 years; p = 0.008). No significant differences in PFS or OS were observed between the two groups (3-year PFS, 78% vs. 81%; 3-year OS, 90% vs. HBV reactivation occurred in five anti-HBc-positive patients. Baseline anti-HBc positivity was more common in older patients but was not associated with inferior outcomes in HBsAg-negative DLBCL treated with rituximab-containing CHOP-based therapy.Clinical trial registration: JCOG0601 was registered in the Japan Registry of Clinical Trials (jRCTs031180139, date of registration; February 20, 2019).

papers.title: White Blood Cell to HDL ‐C Ratio and Sarcopenia: A Dual‐Cohort Analysis Including Exploratory Insights on Hepatitis B History
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Sarcopenia, driven by inflammation and lipid dysregulation, lacks inexpensive screening tools. The white blood cell to HDL‐C ratio (WHR) integrates these pathways, but its utility for sarcopenia screening remains unvalidated. Objective This study evaluated the WHR‐sarcopenia association in dual cohorts, validated it using machine learning, and explored potential effect modification of hepatitis B virus (HBV) status. Methods We analyzed 10 131 NHANES (2011–2018) and 7872 KNHANES (2010–2011) adults. Sarcopenia was defined via DXA using FNIH/AWGS criteria. Weighted logistic regression, restricted cubic splines, and machine learning (LASSO, XGBoost) were applied. Results Higher ln(WHR) was independently associated with sarcopenia in NHANES (adjusted OR = 2.50; 95% CI: 2.01–3.10) and consistently validated in KNHANES (OR = 1.85; 95% CI: 1.49–2.29). WHR ranked among the top predictive features across machine learning models. Exploratory stratified analysis suggests that the association between ln(WHR) and sarcopenia appears to be stronger in the HBV‐exposed subgroup. However, although the formal interaction test was not significant ( p = 0.270), these findings are hypothesis‐generating results. Conclusion WHR, a cost‐free routine metric, is robustly linked to sarcopenia. Integrating it into geriatric assessments could facilitate early high‐risk identification for timely interventions, while exploratory findings suggesting a possible modifying role of HBV history require prospective validation.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Sarcopenia, driven by inflammation and lipid dysregulation, lacks inexpensive screening tools. The white blood cell to HDL‐C ratio (WHR) integrates these pathways, but its utility for sarcopenia screening remains unvalidated.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This study evaluated the WHR‐sarcopenia association in dual cohorts, validated it using machine learning, and explored potential effect modification of hepatitis B virus (HBV) status. We analyzed 10 131 NHANES (2011–2018) and 7872 KNHANES (2010–2011) adults.
analysis_en.methods: Sarcopenia was defined via DXA using FNIH/AWGS criteria. Weighted logistic regression, restricted cubic splines, and machine learning (LASSO, XGBoost) were applied. WHR ranked among the top predictive features across machine learning models.
analysis_en.main_results: Higher ln(WHR) was independently associated with sarcopenia in NHANES (adjusted OR = 2.50; 95% CI: 2.01–3.10) and consistently validated in KNHANES (OR = 1.85; 95% CI: 1.49–2.29).
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: Exploratory stratified analysis suggests that the association between ln(WHR) and sarcopenia appears to be stronger in the HBV‐exposed subgroup. However, although the formal interaction test was not significant ( p = 0.270), these findings are hypothesis‐generating results.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: WHR, a cost‐free routine metric, is robustly linked to sarcopenia. Integrating it into geriatric assessments could facilitate early high‐risk identification for timely interventions, while exploratory findings suggesting a possible modifying role of HBV history require prospective validation.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report explicit limitations related to the study design or statistical methods. The evidence strength is moderate due to the exploratory nature of the HBV-related findings and the lack of significant interaction test results.

papers.title_zh: 白细胞与高密度脂蛋白胆固醇比值与肌少症:一项双中心分析及对乙型肝炎病毒史的探索性分析
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Background Sarcopenia, driven by inflammation and lipid dysregulation, lacks inexpensive screening tools. The white blood cell to HDL‐C ratio (WHR) integrates these pathways, but its utility for sarcopenia screening remains unvalidated. Objective This study evaluated the WHR‐sarcopenia association in dual cohorts, validated it using machine learning, and explored potential effect modification of hepatitis B virus (HBV) status. Methods We analyzed 10 131 NHANES (2011–2018) and 7872 KNHANES (2010–2011) adults. Sarcopenia was defined via DXA using FNIH/AWGS criteria. Weighted logistic regression, restricted cubic splines, and machine learning (LASSO, XGBoost) were applied. Results Higher ln(WHR) was independently associated with sarcopenia in NHANES (adjusted OR = 2.50; 95% CI: 2.01–3.10) and consistently validated in KNHANES (OR = 1.85; 95% CI: 1.49–2.29). WHR ranked among the top predictive features across machine learning models. Exploratory stratified analysis suggests that the association between ln(WHR) and sarcopenia appears to be stronger in the HBV‐exposed subgroup. However, although the formal interaction test was not significant ( p = 0.270), these findings are hypothesis‐generating results. Conclusion WHR, a cost‐free routine metric, is robustly linked to sarcopenia. Integrating it into geriatric assessments could facilitate early high‐risk identification for timely interventions, while exploratory findings suggesting a possible modifying role of HBV history require prospective validation.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 肌少症由炎症和脂质调节紊乱驱动,缺乏经济实惠的筛查工具。白细胞与高密度脂蛋白胆固醇比值(WHR)整合了这些通路,但其在肌少症筛查中的作用尚未得到验证。目的 本研究评估了WHR与肌少症之间的关联,通过双中心分析进行验证,并探讨了乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)状态对这种关联的潜在效应修饰。方法 我们分析了10131名NHANES(2011–2018)和7872名KNHANES(2010–2011)成年人的数据。根据FNIH/AWGS标准,通过双能X射线吸收法(DXA)定义肌少症。应用加权逻辑回归、受限立方样条和机器学习(LASSO、XGBoost)方法。结果 NHANES中较高的ln(WHR)与肌少症独立相关(调整后OR = 2.50;95% CI:2.01–3.10),并在KNHANES中一致验证(OR = 1.85;95% CI:1.49–2.29)。WHR在机器学习模型中位列预测特征的前列。探索性分层分析表明,ln(WHR)与肌少症之间的关联在乙型肝炎病毒暴露亚组中似乎更强。然而,尽管正式的交互作用检验不显著(p = 0.270),这些发现仍具有生成假设的意义。结论 WHR是一种无成本的常规指标,与肌少症有强关联。将其纳入老年评估可有助于早期识别高风险个体,从而及时干预。然而,探索性结果提示乙型肝炎病毒史可能具有潜在的修饰作用,需要前瞻性验证。

papers.title: Intracellular Zn2+ levels regulate susceptibility to hepatitis B virus infection by modulating NTCP-mediated viral entry.
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a significant global health challenge and is a leading cause of chronic liver diseases, including cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. Although nucleos(t)ide analogs and interferon-based therapies suppress viral replication, they do not eliminate the viral reservoir, highlighting the need for novel therapeutic strategies. HBV utilizes the sodium taurocholate cotransporting polypeptide (NTCP) as a key receptor for hepatocyte entry; however, the underlying mechanisms governing this process remain incompletely understood. In this study, we demonstrate that intracellular Zn 2+ levels, regulated by zinc transporter 1 (ZnT1), also known as solute carrier family 30 member 1 (SLC30A1), serve as critical modulators of HBV entry. Zinc supplementation significantly reduced both HBV and hepatitis D virus infection in NTCP-expressing hepatocytes without affecting post-entry replication steps. Knockout or knockdown of SLC30A1 led to intracellular Zn 2+ accumulation and impaired HBV infection, effects reversed by re-expression of functional SLC30A1 or treatment with the Zn 2+ chelator TPEN. Mechanistically, elevated Zn 2+ levels disrupted NTCP-mediated HBV/HDV internalization and bile acid uptake, implicating Zn 2+ in the regulation of receptor activity. RNA sequencing analysis further revealed transcriptional reprogramming of metabolic and bile acid-associated pathways in Zn 2+ -treated cells. Collectively, these findings reveal a role for intracellular zinc homeostasis in regulating HBV entry and implicate the SLC30A1-Zn2+-NTCP axis in this process.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染仍然是全球重要的健康挑战,并是导致慢性肝病(包括肝硬化和肝细胞癌)的主要原因。尽管核苷(酸)类似物和基于干扰素的治疗可以抑制病毒复制,但它们无法清除病毒储存宿主,凸显了开发新型治疗策略的必要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究旨在通过调节NTCP介导的病毒入侵来探讨细胞内Zn2+水平在调控HBV入侵中的作用。研究使用了表达NTCP的肝细胞,并涉及RNA测序分析。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究利用RNA测序分析了Zn2+处理细胞中的代谢和胆汁酸相关通路。此外,还通过敲除或敲减SLC30A1以及使用Zn2+螯合剂TPEN结合治疗来评估其对HBV感染的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 补充锌显著降低了NTCP表达肝细胞中HBV和肝炎D病毒的感染,而不会影响入侵后的复制步骤。机制上,Zn2+水平升高破坏了NTCP介导的HBV/HDV内化和胆汁酸摄取,表明Zn2+在调节受体活性中起作用。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 敲除或敲减SLC30A1导致细胞内Zn2+积累并损害HBV感染,这些效应可通过重新表达功能性SLC30A1或与Zn2+螯合剂TPEN结合的治疗逆转。这些发现表明细胞内锌稳态在调控HBV入侵中起作用,并暗示了SLC30A1-Zn2+-NTCP轴在此过程中的作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,针对细胞内Zn2+水平可能是一种治疗HBV感染的新策略。这可能对开发新的治疗并改善患者预后产生影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于使用了体外模型,这可能无法完全反映体内条件。此外,样本量和特定宿主人群未详细说明,这可能影响结果的普遍性。证据强度为中等。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究旨在通过调节NTCP介导的病毒入侵来探讨细胞内Zn2+水平在调控HBV入侵中的作用。研究使用了表达NTCP的肝细胞,并涉及RNA测序分析。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究利用RNA测序分析了Zn2+处理细胞中的代谢和胆汁酸相关通路。此外,还通过敲除或敲减SLC30A1以及使用Zn2+螯合剂TPEN结合治疗来评估其对HBV感染的影响。
analysis_zh.main_results: 补充锌显著降低了NTCP表达肝细胞中HBV和肝炎D病毒的感染,而不会影响入侵后的复制步骤。机制上,Zn2+水平升高破坏了NTCP介导的HBV/HDV内化和胆汁酸摄取,表明Zn2+在调节受体活性中起作用。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 敲除或敲减SLC30A1导致细胞内Zn2+积累并损害HBV感染,这些效应可通过重新表达功能性SLC30A1或与Zn2+螯合剂TPEN结合的治疗逆转。这些发现表明细胞内锌稳态在调控HBV入侵中起作用,并暗示了SLC30A1-Zn2+-NTCP轴在此过程中的作用。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,针对细胞内Zn2+水平可能是一种治疗HBV感染的新策略。这可能对开发新的治疗并改善患者预后产生影响。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于使用了体外模型,这可能无法完全反映体内条件。此外,样本量和特定宿主人群未详细说明,这可能影响结果的普遍性。证据强度为中等。

papers.title: Association Between EBV Lytic Replication and Liver Injury in Patients With HBeAg‐Negative Chronic HBV Infection
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The present study aims to characterize the impact of Epstein‐Barr virus (EBV) lytic replication on liver disease in patients with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection. We retrospectively enrolled 261 patients with HBeAg‐negative chronic HBV infection who were admitted to Zhongnan Hospital between 2019 and 2025. Plasma levels of HBV‐DNA, EBV‐DNA, and liver function parameters were collected. Patients were grouped based on their viral DNA status, and the association between viral DNA status and liver function was evaluated. Compared to the HBV‐DNA‐negative group, HBV‐DNA‐positivity was significantly associated with aggravated hepatic injury, as evidenced by elevated ALT, AST, lymphocyte count, and fibrosis scores (APRI and FIB‐4). Notably, regardless of HBV‐DNA status or the stage of liver disease (CHB or LC), EBV‐DNA‐positivity was consistently associated with significantly lower plasma albumin (Alb) levels and albumin‐to‐globulin (A/G) ratio compared to EBV‐DNA‐negative patients. The reduction in the A/G ratio was attributable to decreased Alb levels rather than to elevated globulin (Glb) levels. These results suggest that EBV lytic replication was associated with hypoalbuminemia in this study. Circulating EBV‐DNA status holds promise as a potential biomarker for monitoring disease progression, or assessing disease severity in patients with chronic HBV infection.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the association between Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) lytic replication and liver injury in patients with HBeAg-negative chronic HBV infection. It retrospectively enrolled 261 patients from Zhongnan Hospital between 2019 and 2025, analyzing plasma levels of HBV-DNA, EBV-DNA, and liver function parameters. Results showed that HBV-DNA positivity was linked to worsened liver injury, while EBV-DNA positivity was consistently associated with lower plasma albumin and albumin-to-globulin ratio, independent of HBV status or liver disease stage. The findings suggest EBV lytic replication may contribute to hypoalbuminemia in these patients, highlighting its potential as a biomarker for disease severity. However, the study's retrospective nature and possible confounding factors limit the strength of the evidence, though the results are supported by direct measurements.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨Epstein-Barr病毒(EBV)溶性复制对乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染患者肝病的影响。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究回顾性分析了2019年至2025年间在中南医院就诊的261例HBeAg阴性慢性HBV感染患者。根据病毒DNA状态将患者分组,并评估病毒DNA状态与肝功能之间的关联。
elements_zh.methods: 收集了患者的血浆HBV-DNA、EBV-DNA水平以及肝功能参数。通过分组并评估两者之间的关系,分析病毒DNA状态与肝功能的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 与HBV-DNA阴性组相比,HBV-DNA阳性与肝损伤加重显著相关,表现为ALT、AST升高,淋巴细胞计数增加以及纤维化评分(APRI和FIB-4)升高。无论HBV-DNA状态如何或肝病阶段(慢性乙型肝炎或肝硬化),EBV-DNA阳性均与血浆白蛋白(Alb)水平和白蛋白-球蛋白(A/G)比值显著降低相关,与EBV-DNA阴性患者相比。A/G比值的降低归因于白蛋白水平的下降,而非球蛋白(Glb)水平的升高。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些结果表明,在本研究中,EBV溶性复制与低白蛋白血症相关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 循环EBV-DNA状态可能作为监测慢性HBV感染患者疾病进展或评估疾病严重程度的潜在生物标志物。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其回顾性设计和潜在的混杂因素,但证据较强,因为其基于病毒DNA和肝功能参数的直接测量。

Regardless of HBV-DNA status or the stage of liver disease (CHB or LC), EBV-DNA-positivity was consistently associated with significantly lower plasma albumin (Alb) levels and albumin-to-globulin (A/G) ratio compared to EBV-DNA-negative patients. The reduction in the A/G ratio was attributable to decreased Alb levels rather than to elevated globulin (Glb) levels.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: These results suggest that EBV lytic replication was associated with hypoalbuminemia in this study.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Circulating EBV-DNA status holds promise as a potential biomarker for monitoring disease progression or assessing disease severity in patients with chronic HBV infection.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and potential confounding factors, but the evidence is strong as it is based on direct measurements of viral DNA and liver function parameters.

papers.title_zh: EBV溶性复制与HBeAg阴性慢性HBV感染患者肝损伤之间的关联
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT The present study aims to characterize the impact of Epstein‐Barr virus (EBV) lytic replication on liver disease in patients with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection. We retrospectively enrolled 261 patients with HBeAg‐negative chronic HBV infection who were admitted to Zhongnan Hospital between 2019 and 2025. Plasma levels of HBV‐DNA, EBV‐DNA, and liver function parameters were collected. Patients were grouped based on their viral DNA status, and the association between viral DNA status and liver function was evaluated. Compared to the HBV‐DNA‐negative group, HBV‐DNA‐positivity was significantly associated with aggravated hepatic injury, as evidenced by elevated ALT, AST, lymphocyte count, and fibrosis scores (APRI and FIB‐4). Notably, regardless of HBV‐DNA status or the stage of liver disease (CHB or LC), EBV‐DNA‐positivity was consistently associated with significantly lower plasma albumin (Alb) levels and albumin‐to‐globulin (A/G) ratio compared to EBV‐DNA‐negative patients. The reduction in the A/G ratio was attributable to decreased Alb levels rather than to elevated globulin (Glb) levels. These results suggest that EBV lytic replication was associated with hypoalbuminemia in this study. Circulating EBV‐DNA status holds promise as a potential biomarker for monitoring disease progression, or assessing disease severity in patients with chronic HBV infection.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究旨在探讨Epstein-Barr病毒(EBV)溶性复制对乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染患者肝病的影响。我们回顾性纳入了2019年至2025年间在中南医院就诊的261例HBeAg阴性慢性HBV感染患者。收集了患者的血浆HBV-DNA、EBV-DNA水平以及肝功能参数。根据病毒DNA状态将患者分组,并评估病毒DNA状态与肝功能之间的关联。与HBV-DNA阴性组相比,HBV-DNA阳性与肝损伤加重显著相关,表现为ALT、AST升高,淋巴细胞计数增加以及纤维化评分(APRI和FIB-4)升高。值得注意的是,无论HBV-DNA状态如何或肝病阶段(慢性乙型肝炎或肝硬化),EBV-DNA阳性均与血浆白蛋白(Alb)水平和白蛋白-球蛋白(A/G)比值显著降低相关,与EBV-DNA阴性患者相比。A/G比值的降低归因于白蛋白水平的下降,而非球蛋白(Glb)水平的升高。这些结果表明,在本研究中,EBV溶性复制与低白蛋白血症相关。循环EBV-DNA状态可能作为监测慢性HBV感染患者疾病进展或评估疾病严重程度的潜在生物标志物。

papers.title: Point of Care Diagnostics for Hepatitis B and C in Low-resource Settings: A Narrative Review
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) and Hepatitis C Virus (HCV) continue to be major public health challenge especially in Low- and MiddleIncome Countries (LMICs), with poor laboratory capacity and the ability to detect the disease earlier and contribute to its management. Proper and timely diagnosis is crucial for clinical intervention and global elimination. The present narrative review explores the potential for the use of Point-Of-Care (POC) testing to enhance the testing of HBV and HCV in low-resource settings. Peer-reviewed literature, global health reports, and grey literature were reviewed to assess the state of the art of POC technologies, diagnostic performance, and implementation in resource-limited settings, as well as new developments. Existing challenges and future opportunities for improving access to timely and effective HBV and HCV diagnosis are also pointed out. New technologies and features, such as mobile healthcare integration, Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered interpretation, and self-testing, enhance their capabilities. There are still areas of challenge, including uneven policy adoption, supply chain issues, and social stigma, that make it difficult to scale. POC diagnostics have the potential to accelerate hepatitis elimination by improving access to rapid testing. Their successful implementation requires strengthened health systems, trained healthcare workers, and integration into existing healthcare services.
papers.journal: JOURNAL OF CLINICAL AND DIAGNOSTIC RESEARCH

analysis.summary_en: This narrative review focuses on the role of Point-Of-Care (POC) diagnostics in addressing the public health challenges posed by Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) in low-resource settings. The review highlights the importance of timely diagnosis for effective clinical intervention and global elimination efforts. It explores the potential of POC technologies to enhance testing capabilities, particularly in Low- and Middle-Income Countries (LMICs), where laboratory infrastructure is limited. The review also identifies key challenges, such as uneven policy adoption, supply chain issues, and social stigma, which hinder the scalability of POC diagnostics. The review concludes that while POC diagnostics offer promising opportunities, further research and policy development are required to overcome current limitations and improve access to HBV diagnosis.

papers.title: Realizing personalized prediction for the reversal of chronic hepatitis B-associated liver fibrosis through machine learning
papers.abstract: Although long-term antiviral therapy can reverse liver fibrosis in a considerable proportion of patients with chronic hepatitis B, treatment response differs markedly among individuals, and reliable methods for predicting who will benefit remain lacking. Conventional clinical tools such as liver stiffness measurement and the aspartate aminotransferase-to-platelet ratio index were originally dewsigned for cross-sectional staging rather than longitudinal prediction, and their ability to capture the dynamic process of fibrosis reversal is limited. In this opinion review, we discuss how machine learning (ML) may help address this unmet need. We focus on three areas where ML has shown early but encouraging results: Quantitative analysis of images using ML, integration of pathological and clinical data through multimodal models, and dynamic prediction of treatment response based on serial measurements during antiviral therapy. In our view, the greatest value of ML lies not in replacing existing assessment tools but in complementing them, particularly through the early identification of patients who are unlikely to achieve fibrosis reversal with antiviral therapy alone. However, we also caution that most current models have been developed from small, single-center retrospective cohorts, and their clinical adoption will require prospective multi-center validation, improved model interpretability, and adherence to standardized reporting frameworks.

papers.abstract_zh: 尽管长期抗病毒药物治疗可以逆转慢性乙型肝炎患者的肝纤维化,但个体对治疗的反应差异显著,目前仍缺乏可靠的预测方法。传统的临床工具如肝硬度测量和天门冬氨酸氨基转移酶与血小板比值指数最初设计用于横断面分期,而非纵向预测,其捕捉纤维化逆转动态过程的能力有限。在本观点综述中,我们讨论了机器学习(ML)如何帮助解决这一未满足的需求。我们重点关注了机器学习在三个方面的早期但有希望的结果:利用机器学习进行图像的定量分析、通过多模态模型整合病理和临床数据,以及基于抗病毒药物治疗期间的连续测量动态预测治疗反应。我们认为,机器学习的最大价值并不在于取代现有评估工具,而在于补充它们,特别是在早期识别那些仅通过抗病毒药物治疗难以实现纤维化逆转的患者方面。然而,我们也提醒,目前大多数模型都是基于小规模、单中心的回顾性队列研究开发的,其临床应用需要前瞻性多中心验证、提高模型的可解释性以及遵循标准化的报告框架。

papers.title: Prognostic value of Glasgow prognostic score in patients with advanced hepatitis-B virus-related hepatocellular carcinoma undergoing hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy combined with lenvatinib and toripalimab.
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: This study aimed to evaluate the Glasgow Prognostic Score (GPS) in predicting prognosis in patients with advanced hepatitis-B virus-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HBV-HCC) who are undergoing hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy (HAIC) combined with lenvatinib and toripalimab therapy. MATERIALS AND METHODS: In this single-center retrospective study, patients with advanced HBV-HCC who received treatment with HAIC combined with lenvatinib and toripalimab from March 2019 to November 2021 were analyzed. The patients were divided into two groups based on GPS, and propensity score matching (PSM) was used to assess progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS) in both groups. RESULTS: Of the 58 patients, 37 were included in the study. Thirteen patients were in the GPS score 0 group and 24 in the GPS score 1 group. After PSM, eight pairs were selected. Patients in the GPS score 0 group had significantly longer median PFS before (10.2 versus 4.3 months, P = 0.009) and after PSM (5.6 versus 1.9 months, P = 0.026). Similarly, OS was significantly longer in the GPS score 0 group before (32.0 versus 9.7 months, P < 0.001) and after PSM (32.0 versus 8.6 months, P < 0.001). GPS was an independent prognostic factor for OS, with borderline significance for PFS. In addition, tumor number was identified as an independent prognostic factor for PFS. CONCLUSION: This exploratory study provides preliminary evidence that GPS may serve as a prognostic factor for patients with advanced HBV-related HCC who were receiving a triple-combination therapy, requiring further validation in larger cohorts.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the Glasgow Prognostic Score (GPS) as a prognostic tool for patients with advanced hepatitis-B virus-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HBV-HCC) undergoing hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy (HAIC) combined with lenvatinib and toripalimab. A single-center retrospective analysis of 58 patients, with 37 included in the study, divided them into GPS score 0 and 1 groups. Propensity score matching (PSM) was used to compare progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS). Results showed that patients in the GPS score 0 group had significantly longer median PFS (10.2 vs. 4.3 months, P = 0.009) and OS (32.0 vs. 9.7 months, P < 0.001) before and after PSM. GPS was an independent prognostic factor for OS, with borderline significance for PFS. Tumor number was also identified as an independent prognostic factor for PFS. The findings suggest GPS may be useful in predicting outcomes for patients with advanced HBV-related HCC on triple-combination therapy, though further validation in larger cohorts is needed. papers.title: Systemic Inflammation and the Persistence of Vaccine-Induced Hepatitis B Immunity in Healthcare Workers
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND The long-term persistence of hepatitis B surface antigen (anti-HBs) levels varies among individuals, and the role of systemic inflammation remains unclear. This study evaluated the relationship between anti-HBs antibody levels and systemic inflammatory markers in healthcare workers. MATERIAL AND METHODS This longitudinal observational study with a retrospective component included 583 healthcare workers who underwent routine occupational health screening between 2023 and 2025. Anti-HBs levels at 2 time points were analyzed together with C-reactive protein (CRP) level, neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio, platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio, systemic immune-inflammation index, and systemic inflammation response index. Nonparametric and correlation analyses were performed. RESULTS Anti-HBs levels decreased significantly between baseline and follow-up (Hodges-Lehmann estimate: -23.00 mIU/mL, 95% CI: -27.60 to -18.93; P<0.001). No significant associations were observed between antibody levels and sex, smoking status, or the neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio, platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio, systemic immune-inflammation index, and systemic inflammation response index. In contrast, CRP positivity was associated with lower anti-HBs levels at the second measurement; however, no association was observed between CRP and longitudinal change in anti-HBs levels. Higher anti-HBs levels were observed among physicians and healthcare workers in the very high occupational biological-risk group, whereas age showed a weak negative correlation with antibody levels. CONCLUSIONS CRP showed a weak cross-sectional association with lower anti-HBs levels at the second measurement, whereas no association was observed between CRP or the other inflammatory indices and longitudinal change in anti-HBs levels. Therefore, the present findings do not establish systemic inflammation as a determinant of longitudinal antibody persistence. Further longitudinal studies are required to determine whether systemic inflammatory markers have clinical utility in post-vaccination immunity monitoring.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项具有回顾性成分的纵向观察性研究,纳入了2023年至2025年间接受常规职业健康筛查的583名医疗工作者。研究评估了anti-HBs抗体水平与系统性炎症标志物之间的关系。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,CRP在第二次测量时与较低的anti-HBs水平存在弱的横断面关联,但未观察到CRP或其他炎症指标与anti-HBs水平纵向变化之间的关联。这些发现表明,系统性炎症可能不是anti-HBs水平纵向持续性的决定因素。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其观察性设计以及未能控制潜在的混杂因素。证据强度中等,因为研究结果并未建立系统性炎症与抗体持续性之间的因果关系。

papers.title: Family cluster screening may help identify hepatitis D virus infections among individuals from highly endemic regions.
papers.abstract: Hepatitis D virus (HDV) infection is the most severe form of chronic viral hepatitis and may remain substantially underdiagnosed, particularly among individuals originating from highly endemic regions. We report a Romanian family cluster identified through cascade screening following the diagnosis of an index case living in Spain. Six household contacts and first-degree relatives underwent hepatitis B virus (HBV) and HDV screening, identifying three additional cases of chronic HDV infection. Notably, all affected individuals had advanced liver disease at diagnosis, and two subsequently required liver transplantation. Two patients reported having been aware of their HBV diagnosis but were no longer engaged to healthcare follow-up and had not undergone HDV screening. This family cluster highlights the potential value of cascade screening of household contacts and first-degree relatives for identifying HDV infection, particularly among families originating from HDV-endemic regions. It also illustrates the clinical consequences of delayed diagnosis, including presentation with advanced liver disease and limited therapeutic opportunities. Family cluster case-finding could therefore represent a useful complementary strategy to systematic HDV screening in at-risk populations.

analysis.summary_en: This study highlights the importance of family cluster screening in identifying hepatitis D virus (HDV) infections among individuals from highly endemic regions. The research reports a Romanian family cluster where cascade screening following the diagnosis of an index case in Spain revealed three additional chronic HDV infections. Notably, two of the affected individuals had advanced liver disease and required liver transplantation. The findings suggest that cascade screening of household contacts and first-degree relatives may be a valuable strategy for detecting HDV infections, especially in populations at risk. The study also emphasizes the clinical consequences of delayed diagnosis, such as advanced liver disease and limited treatment options. However, the study is limited to a single family cluster, which may affect the generalizability of the results. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the small sample size and the focus on a specific case.

papers.abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒(HDV)感染是最严重的慢性病毒性肝炎形式,可能在来自高流行地区的个体中显著未被诊断。我们报告了一例西班牙居住的索引病例通过筛查后发现的罗马尼亚家庭聚集情况。六名家庭成员和一级亲属接受了乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)和HDV筛查,发现了三例额外的慢性HDV感染病例。值得注意的是,所有受影响的个体在筛查时均患有晚期肝病,其中两人随后需要进行肝移植。两名患者报告称他们曾知晓自己的HBV感染状况,但已不再接受医疗随访且未进行HDV筛查。该家庭聚集情况突显了对家庭成员和一级亲属进行级联筛查在识别HDV感染方面的潜在价值,特别是在来自HDV流行地区的家庭中。它还说明了延迟筛查的临床后果,包括出现晚期肝病和治疗机会有限。因此,家庭聚集病例发现可能代表一种在高风险人群中系统性HDV筛查的有用补充策略。

papers.title: Knowledge, attitudes and practices regarding prevention of hepatitis B virus mother-to-child transmission among health professionals in a semi-rural health district of Cameroon: a cross-sectional study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major public health problem in Cameroon, a country of high endemicity where mother-to-child transmission accounts for a substantial proportion of chronic infections, with more than 90% of infections acquired at birth progressing to chronicity compared with less than 5% among adults. Prevention of HBV mother-to-child transmission (PMTCT) depends directly on the knowledge, attitudes, and practices of health workers providing maternity and immunization services, which remain poorly documented in semi-urban and rural health districts of Cameroon. This study aimed to assess these three dimensions among health professionals in the Obala Health District and to identify the factors associated with each. Methods An analytical cross-sectional study was conducted from April to June 2026 among health workers providing antenatal, maternity, and immunization services across the 33 health facilities of the Obala Health District, Centre Region, Cameroon. All 145 eligible staff were approached exhaustively; data were collected using a structured, pre-tested questionnaire under strict conditions of anonymity and confidentiality, and analyzed using IBM SPSS version 27.0. Scores were expressed as a percentage of the theoretical maximum and dichotomized at the 85% threshold (good/appropriate/adequate versus the remaining categories combined) for multivariable analysis. Multivariable binary logistic regression identified factors associated with good knowledge, appropriate attitudes, and adequate practices at p

analysis.study_design_and_population: This study aimed to assess these three dimensions among health professionals in the Obala Health District and to identify the factors associated with each.
analysis.methods: An analytical cross-sectional study was conducted from April to June 2026 among health workers providing antenatal, maternity, and immunization services across the 33 health facilities of the Obala Health District, Centre Region, Cameroon. All 145 eligible staff were approached exhaustively; data were collected using a structured, pre-tested questionnaire under strict conditions of anonymity and confidentiality, and analyzed using IBM SPSS version 27.0.
analysis.main_results: Scores were expressed as a percentage of the theoretical maximum and dichotomized at the 85% threshold (good/appropriate/adequate versus the remaining categories combined) for multivariable analysis.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Prevention of HBV mother-to-child transmission (PMTCT) depends directly on the knowledge, attitudes, and practices of health workers providing maternity and immunization services, which remain poorly documented in semi-urban and rural health districts of Cameroon.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform targeted interventions to improve health professionals' knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding PMTCT in semi-rural health districts of Cameroon.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to an abstract-only analysis, and the evidence strength is moderate due to the lack of detailed results and statistical analyses.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study assessed the knowledge, attitudes, and practices of health professionals in the Obala Health District of Cameroon regarding the prevention of hepatitis B virus (HBV) mother-to-child transmission. The study highlights the critical role of health workers in PMTCT and identifies the need for improved documentation of these practices in semi-urban and rural health districts. The findings suggest that targeted interventions could enhance PMTCT efforts, but the study's evidence strength is moderate due to its abstract-only nature. The research underscores the importance of understanding health professionals' behaviors in combating HBV transmission, particularly in high-endemicity regions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染仍然是喀麦隆的主要公共卫生问题,该国为HBV高流行地区,母婴传播传播占慢性感染的相当大比例,其中超过90%的出生时获得的感染会发展为慢性感染,而成人中则少于5%。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究旨在评估Obala卫生区健康专业人员在这三个维度上的情况,并确定与每个维度相关的因素。
elements_zh.methods: 2026年4月至6月期间,在喀麦隆Centre地区Obala卫生区的33个卫生机构中,对提供产前检查、产科和免疫接种服务的卫生工作者进行了分析性横断面研究。所有145名符合条件的工作人员均被充分接触;数据通过结构化的、预测试的问卷在严格保密和匿名条件下收集,并使用IBM SPSS版本27.0进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 得分以理论最大值的百分比表示,并在85%的阈值处进行二分类(良好/适当/充分与其余类别合并)以进行多变量分析。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 预防HBV母婴传播传播(PMTCT)直接取决于提供产科和免疫接种服务的卫生工作者的知识、态度和实践,这些在喀麦隆的半城市和农村卫生区中仍缺乏充分记录。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为改善喀麦隆半农村地区卫生专业人员对PMTCT的知识、态度和实践提供有针对性的干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于摘要分析,由于缺乏详细结果和统计分析,证据强度中等。

papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major public health problem in Cameroon, a country of high endemicity where mother-to-child transmission accounts for a substantial proportion of chronic infections, with more than 90% of infections acquired at birth progressing to chronicity compared with less than 5% among adults. Prevention of HBV mother-to-child transmission (PMTCT) depends directly on the knowledge, attitudes, and practices of health workers providing maternity and immunization services, which remain poorly documented in semi-urban and rural health districts of Cameroon. This study aimed to assess these three dimensions among health professionals in the Obala Health District and to identify the factors associated with each. Methods An analytical cross-sectional study was conducted from April to June 2026 among health workers providing antenatal, maternity, and immunization services across the 33 health facilities of the Obala Health District, Centre Region, Cameroon. All 145 eligible staff were approached exhaustively; data were collected using a structured, pre-tested questionnaire under strict conditions of anonymity and confidentiality, and analyzed using IBM SPSS version 27.0. Scores were expressed as a percentage of the theoretical maximum and dichotomized at the 85% threshold (good/appropriate/adequate versus the remaining categories combined) for multivariable analysis. papers.title: Predictors of Antibody Response to Hepatitis B Vaccination in Hemodialysis Patients.
papers.abstract: End-stage renal disease (ESRD) patients receiving maintenance hemodialysis are at high risk of hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection and demonstrate inadequate immune response to vaccination. The objective of the study was to assess the antibody response (anti-HBs levels) of hepatitis B vaccinated maintenance hemodialysis patients. This cross-sectional observational analytical study was conducted at Marine City Medical College Hospital, Chittagong, Bangladesh for 34 months of period among 50 patients receiving maintenance hemodialysis for more than 4 months. Demographic and clinical data were collected and post-vaccination anti-HBs titers were measured. Patients were classified as high responders (anti-HBs ≥100 mIU/ml), poor responders (anti-HBs ≥10 to 50 years, presence of diabetes mellitus and lower serum albumin were significantly associated with poor or non response (p<0.05). Development of protective antibody levels after hepatitis B vaccination in maintenance hemodialysis patients was inadequate. Older age, diabetes and low serum albumin were important predictors of poor response. Strategies such as booster dosing and revaccination may improve seroconversion rates in this population.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Hemodialysis patients are at high risk of hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection and show inadequate immune response to vaccination. The study aimed to assess predictors of antibody response to hepatitis B vaccination in this population.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional observational analytical study was conducted at Marine City Medical College Hospital, Chittagong, Bangladesh over 34 months among 50 patients receiving maintenance hemodialysis for more than 4 months.
analysis.methods: Demographic and clinical data were collected, and post-vaccination anti-HBs titers were measured to classify patients as high responders or poor responders.
analysis.main_results: Older age, presence of diabetes mellitus, and lower serum albumin were significantly associated with poor or non-response to hepatitis B vaccination (p<0.05).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight that certain clinical factors are important predictors of inadequate antibody response to hepatitis B vaccination in hemodialysis patients.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results can inform strategies for improving seroconversion rates in hemodialysis patients through targeted interventions such as booster dosing and revaccination.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its observational design and small sample size, but the evidence is strong given the clear association between clinical factors and poor response.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated predictors of antibody response to hepatitis B vaccination in hemodialysis patients. It found that older age, diabetes mellitus, and lower serum albumin levels were significantly associated with poor or non-response. These findings suggest that targeted strategies such as booster dosing and revaccination may improve seroconversion rates in this vulnerable population. The study was conducted as a cross-sectional observational analytical study at a single hospital in Bangladesh over 34 months, involving 50 patients. While the study provides important insights, its small sample size and observational design limit the generalizability of the results. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the clear statistical associations reported.

papers.title: Completion of Hepatitis B Vaccination Schedule Among Healthcare Workers in Four Counties in Kenya: A Mixed-Methods Study
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Healthcare workers (HCWs) are at an increased risk of hepatitis B virus infection through occupational exposure, yet completion of the recommended hepatitis B vaccination schedule remains suboptimal in Kenya. We assessed vaccination completion, associated factors, motivators, and barriers among HCWs. Methods: We conducted a mixed-methods study combining a cross-sectional survey of 1614 HCWs in 178 health facilities across Kakamega, Nakuru, Mombasa, and Siaya counties with nine focus group discussions. The survey was conducted in August–September 2023 and the focus groups during June 2024–January 2025. Mixed-effects logistic regression with a random intercept for health facility was used to identify factors associated with completion of three vaccine doses, and qualitative data were analyzed thematically. Results: Among 1583 HCWs with a known vaccination status, 700 (44.2%; 95% CI: 41.8–46.7) reported completing three doses, 410 (25.9%) had received one or two doses, and 473 (29.9%) had never been vaccinated. The main motivator was self-protection (71.7%). Common barriers were vaccine unavailability (57.5%), lack of knowledge (28.8%), the vaccine not being offered on site (28.2%), and cost (17.4%). Completion was more likely among male HCWs, those working in urban areas facilities, and those with 6–10 or 11–20 years of healthcare work experience, and less likely among support staff, administrative staff, clinicians and allied health professionals than among nurses/midwives. Conclusions: Fewer than half of HCWs reported completing the three-dose hepatitis B vaccination schedule. Improving vaccine availability, reducing out-of-pocket costs, strengthening dose-reminder systems, and addressing knowledge gaps may improve completion among HCWs in the study counties.

papers.title_zh: 肯尼亚四个县医疗工作者完成乙型肝炎疫苗接种接种计划的情况:一项混合方法研究
papers.source_body_en: Background/Objectives: Healthcare workers (HCWs) are at an increased risk of hepatitis B virus infection through occupational exposure, yet completion of the recommended hepatitis B vaccination schedule remains suboptimal in Kenya. We assessed vaccination completion, associated factors, motivators, and barriers among HCWs. Methods: We conducted a mixed-methods study combining a cross-sectional survey of 1614 HCWs in 178 health facilities across Kakamega, Nakuru, Mombasa, and Siaya counties with nine focus group discussions. The survey was conducted in August–September 2023 and the focus groups during June 2024–January 2025. Mixed-effects logistic regression with a random intercept for health facility was used to identify factors associated with completion of three vaccine doses, and qualitative data were analyzed thematically. Results: Among 1583 HCWs with a known vaccination status, 700 (44.2%; 95% CI: 41.8–46.7) reported completing three doses, 410 (25.9%) had received one or two doses, and 473 (29.9%) had never been vaccinated. The main motivator was self-protection (71.7%). Common barriers were vaccine unavailability (57.5%), lack of knowledge (28.8%), the vaccine not being offered on site (28.2%), and cost (17.4%). Completion was more likely among male HCWs, those working in urban areas facilities, and those with 6–10 or 11–20 years of healthcare work experience, and less likely among support staff, administrative staff, clinicians and allied health professionals than among nurses/midwives. Conclusions: Fewer than half of HCWs reported completing the three-dose hepatitis B vaccination schedule. Improving vaccine availability, reducing out-of-pocket costs, strengthening dose-reminder systems, and addressing knowledge gaps may improve completion among HCWs in the study counties.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目标:医疗工作者(HCWs)因职业暴露而面临更高的乙型肝炎病毒感染风险,但在肯尼亚完成推荐的乙型肝炎疫苗接种接种计划仍不理想。我们评估了医疗工作者完成三剂疫苗接种接种计划的情况、相关因素、动机和障碍。方法:我们开展了一项混合方法研究,结合了在肯尼亚卡卡梅加、纳库鲁、蒙巴萨和西亚县178家医疗机构中对1614名医疗工作者的横断面调查,以及九次焦点小组讨论。调查于2023年8月至9月进行,焦点小组讨论于2024年6月至2025年1月进行。采用带有医疗机构随机截距的混合效应逻辑回归模型,以确定完成三剂疫苗接种接种计划的相关因素,并对定性数据进行了主题分析。结果:在1583名已知疫苗接种状态的医疗工作者中,700人(44.2%;95% CI:41.8–46.7)报告已完成三剂接种,410人(25.9%)接种了一剂或两剂,473人(29.9%)从未接种过疫苗。主要动机是自我保护(71.7%)。常见的障碍包括疫苗不可用(57.5%)、缺乏知识(28.8%)、疫苗未在机构内提供(28.2%)以及费用(17.4%)。完成接种的比例在男性医疗工作者、在城市地区工作的医疗工作者以及有6–10年或11–20年医疗工作经验的医疗工作者中更高,而在支持人员、行政人员、临床医生和相关医疗专业人员中较低,相较于护士/助产士。结论:在研究的四个县中,不到一半的医疗工作者报告完成了三剂乙型肝炎疫苗接种接种计划。提高疫苗的可获得性、降低自费费用、加强接种提醒系统以及解决知识差距可能有助于提高这些县医疗工作者的接种完成率。

papers.title: Comparative Clinical, Demographic, and Cardiometabolic Profile of Hepatitis B and Hepatitis C Patients in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa: A Cross- Sectional Study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background and Objectives Pakistan is disproportionately affected by HBV and HCV, which continue to be important causes of chronic liver disease. Although there is little evidence in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, worldwide data indicates that infected individuals have different cardiometabolic and demographic characteristics. This study identified independent predictors of hepatitis type by comparing the demographic, cardiometabolic, and clinical characteristics of individuals with HBV and HCV. Methodology This comparative cross-sectional study included 549 laboratory-confirmed patients (249 HBV-positive, 300 HCV-positive) recruited from Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. Demographic, anthropometric, cardiometabolic, vaccination, and symptom data were extracted from clinical records; hypertension was defined using the 2017 ACC/AHA threshold, and presenting symptoms were grouped into seven clinical domains. Normality was assessed using the Shapiro-Wilk test; as continuous variables were non-normally distributed, between-group comparisons used the Mann-Whitney U test, while categorical variables were compared using the Pearson Chi-square test with Cramér's V as effect size. Multivariable binary logistic regression was performed to identify factors independently associated with hepatitis type, with model fit assessed via the Hosmer-Lemeshow goodness-of-fit test and Nagelkerke R2. Results HBV patients were significantly older than HCV patients (41.03±10.61 vs. 36.64±10.35 years, p Conclusion HBV and HCV patients exhibit distinct cardiometabolic risk profiles despite comparable symptom presentation. Hypertension emerged as the strongest independent correlate of hepatitis type, underscoring the value of adjusted analysis in hepatitis comorbidity research.

papers.title_original: Comparative Clinical, Demographic, and Cardiometabolic Profile of Hepatitis B and Hepatitis C Patients in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa: A Cross- Sectional Study

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to compare the demographic, clinical, and cardiometabolic profiles of individuals with hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) infections in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan, to identify independent predictors of hepatitis type.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This cross-sectional study included 549 laboratory-confirmed patients (249 HBV-positive and 300 HCV-positive) recruited from Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan, between 2022 and 2024.
analysis.methods: Demographic, anthropometric, cardiometabolic, vaccination, and symptom data were extracted from clinical records. Hypertension was defined using the 2017 ACC/AHA threshold, and presenting symptoms were grouped into seven clinical domains. Statistical analyses included the Shapiro-Wilk test for normality, Mann-Whitney U test for non-normally distributed continuous variables, and Pearson Chi-square test with Cramér's V as effect size for categorical variables. Multivariable binary logistic regression was used to identify independent predictors of hepatitis type, with model fit assessed via the Hosmer-Lemeshow goodness-of-fit test and Nagelkerke R2.
analysis.main_results: HBV patients were significantly older than HCV patients (41.03±10.61 vs. 36.64±10.35 years, p < 0.001). Hypertension emerged as the strongest independent correlate of hepatitis type.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight distinct cardiometabolic risk profiles between HBV and HCV patients, despite comparable symptom presentation, suggesting the need for tailored approaches in managing these infections.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide insights into the demographic and cardiometabolic differences between HBV and HCV infections, which can inform targeted surveillance and management strategies in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to data from a single region in Pakistan, and the evidence is based on clinical records, which may introduce bias. The confidence in the findings is moderate due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study compared the demographic, clinical, and cardiometabolic profiles of individuals with hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) infections in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. The study included 549 patients, with 249 HBV-positive and 300 HCV-positive individuals. Data were extracted from clinical records, and statistical analyses were performed using the Shapiro-Wilk test, Mann-Whitney U test, Pearson Chi-square test, and multivariable binary logistic regression. The main results showed that HBV patients were significantly older than HCV patients, and hypertension was identified as the strongest independent correlate of hepatitis type. The authors interpreted these findings as highlighting distinct cardiometabolic risk profiles between HBV and HCV patients, despite similar symptom presentation. The study's implications suggest the need for tailored surveillance and management strategies in the region. However, the study is limited to a single geographic area, and the evidence is based on clinical records, which may introduce bias, resulting in moderate confidence in the findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在比较巴基斯坦开伯尔-普什图省HBV和HCV感染个体的人口统计学、临床和心血管代谢特征,以确定肝炎类型的独立预测因素。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项横断面研究纳入了549名实验室确诊的患者(249名HBV阳性和300名HCV阳性),这些患者于2022年至2024年间在巴基斯坦开伯尔-普什图省招募。
elements_zh.methods: 人口统计学、人体测量学、心血管代谢、疫苗接种以及症状数据均从临床记录中提取。高血压采用2017年ACC/AHA标准定义,临床症状被分为七个临床领域。统计分析包括使用Shapiro-Wilk检验评估正态性,使用Mann-Whitney U检验分析非正态分布的连续变量,使用Pearson卡方检验并以Cramér's V作为效应量分析分类变量。采用多变量二元逻辑回归分析确定肝炎类型的独立预测因素,模型拟合度通过Hosmer-Lemeshow拟合优度检验和Nagelkerke R2进行评估。
elements_zh.main_results: HBV患者的年龄显著高于HCV患者(41.03±10.61岁 vs. 36.64±10.35岁,p < 0.001)。高血压是肝炎类型最强的独立相关因素。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果突显了HBV和HCV患者之间在心血管代谢风险特征上的显著差异,尽管两者症状表现相似,这表明在管理这些感染时需要采取针对性的策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果提供了HBV和HCV感染在人口统计学和心血管代谢方面的差异信息,这可以为开伯尔-普什图省的针对性监测和管理策略提供依据。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于巴基斯坦一个地区的数据,且基于临床记录,这可能引入偏倚。由于这些限制,研究结果的可信度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景与目的 巴基斯坦的乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)和丙型肝炎病毒(HCV)感染情况异常严重,仍然是慢性肝病的重要病因。尽管在开伯尔-普什图省(Khyber Pakhtunkhwa)缺乏相关证据,但全球数据显示,感染个体在心血管代谢和人口统计学特征上存在差异。本研究通过比较HBV和HCV感染个体的人口统计学、心血管代谢和临床特征,以确定肝炎类型的独立预测因素。方法 这项比较性横断面研究纳入了549名实验室确诊的患者(249名HBV阳性,300名HCV阳性),来自巴基斯坦开伯尔-普什图省。人口统计学、人体测量学、心血管代谢、疫苗接种以及症状数据均从临床记录中提取;高血压采用2017年ACC/AHA标准定义,临床症状被分为七个临床领域。通过Shapiro-Wilk检验评估数据的正态性;对于非正态分布的连续变量,采用Mann-Whitney U检验进行组间比较,而分类变量则采用Pearson卡方检验,并以Cramér's V作为效应量。通过多变量二元逻辑回归分析确定与肝炎类型独立相关的因素,模型拟合度通过Hosmer-Lemeshow拟合优度检验和Nagelkerke R2进行评估。结果 HBV患者的年龄显著高于HCV患者(41.03±10.61岁 vs. 36.64±10.35岁,p < 0.001)。高血压是肝炎类型最强的独立相关因素。结论 尽管HBV和HCV患者的症状表现相似,但两者在心血管代谢风险特征上存在显著差异,这表明在管理这些感染时需要采取针对性的策略。

papers.title: Mapping Hepatitis B Virus Research and Genomic Diversity in Latin America and the Caribbean
papers.abstract: Background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major public health challenge in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC). Mapping scientific production and viral genomic diversity is essential to identify consolidated research fields, as well as areas of opportunity to improve and expand research across the region. Methods: An integrated analysis combining bibliometrics, text-mining, and phylogenetics was performed on HBV literature indexed in PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science (1970–2025), alongside 9528 GenBank sequences (including full-length genomes, individual genes, and partial diagnostic fragments). Results: A total of 4083 publications were identified, of which 72.1% (2942/4083) were from Brazil, Mexico, and Argentina. Most were original articles (75.8%; 2749/3628) involving human cohorts (95.8%; 2471/2580), where primary research fields centered on serological profiling, co-infections, vaccination, genotype characterization, and blood safety, whereas hepatocellular carcinoma, antiviral therapy, and metabolic comorbidities were the least frequently studied areas. In vitro (10.1%; 260/2580) and animal models (6.9%; 177/2580) accounted for a minor fraction of the literature. Eight circulating HBV genotypes (A–H) were detected, dominated by A (43.4%; 4138/9528), F (29.3%; 2787/9528), and D (19.8%; 1885/9528), while genotype H was largely confined to Mexico (3.2%; 306/9528). Marked geographic clustering was observed (p < 0.001), reflecting both autochthonous American and immigrant lineages. Conclusions: Epidemiological studies represent the most consolidated domain in LAC, yet research remains concentrated in a few countries with persistent experimental and clinical gaps. Fostering cross-border collaboration and investing in underexplored translational areas will be decisive in achieving regional hepatitis B elimination.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染仍然是拉丁美洲和加勒比地区(LAC)的主要公共卫生挑战。绘制科学生产图谱和病毒基因组多样性对于识别已确立的研究领域以及改善和扩展该地区研究的机会至关重要。方法:对PubMed、Scopus和Web of Science(1970–2025)中索引的HBV文献以及9528条GenBank序列(包括完整的乙型肝炎病毒基因组、单个基因和部分诊断片段)进行了整合分析,结合了文献计量学、文本挖掘和系统发育分析。结果:共识别出4083篇文献,其中72.1%(2942/4083)来自巴西、墨西哥和阿根廷。大多数为原始研究文章(75.8%;2749/3628),涉及人类乙型肝炎病毒(95.8%;2471/2580),主要研究领域集中在血清学特征分析、共感染、慢性乙型肝炎、基因型特征分析和血液安全方面,而肝细胞癌、慢性乙型肝炎治疗和代谢共病则是研究较少的领域。体外研究(10.1%;260/2580)和动物模型(6.9%;177/2580)仅占文献的一小部分。检测到8种流行的HBV基因型(A–H),其中A型(43.4%;4138/9528)、F型(29.3%;2787/9528)和D型(19.8%;1885/9528)占主导地位,而H型基因型主要局限于墨西哥(3.2%;306/9528)。观察到显著的地理聚集性(p < 0.001),反映了本地的美洲和移民的病毒谱系。结论:流行病学研究是LAC中最稳固的研究领域,但研究仍集中在少数国家,存在持续的实验和临床研究空白。促进跨境合作并投资于未被充分探索的转化研究领域,将是实现该地区乙肝消除的关键。
